title: Prayer to reach rock musicians answered with calls

tellings.quote: Last year on my birthday, I get a phone call and it's Sammy's wife Ki

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs and has been studied by NASA, says he prayed to reach rock musicians and that his prayers were answered with phone calls. He tells Michels that in 2025, on his birthday, he got a call from the wife of the rock singer Sammy Hagar. He names other rock stars in the same story, and tells it as a sign that his prayers are heard.
